name: Apps reach staging
ownerWords:
and by the way the ultimate goal is to get an accepted version of each app in the prospects view.

what should i review? report status (in 0%-100%) of each tab

only move things to 5174 when i say 5180 is good enough.
goal: Each of the 6 Prospect apps on 5180 (Home, Inbox, Watchlist, Email, Creators, Connections) has an owner pick on Staging. No owner review stays open over 48 h, and virev-demo check and unit pass on sieun/dev. Each run gives the owner each tab's 0 to 100% status.

metrics.label: Prospect apps whose owner pick is on Staging (of 6)
Demo CI green on sieun/dev (virev-demo check and unit)

onMiss: Every run, post one chat line with each tab's % from the tab_status slices, what done means and what is missing (c58). apps_picked under 6: per no_pick app, steer its live step job, else start one with rlm.create_session named '<app> variant set', built against the canonical flows (sessions/2026/10/10/1716-canonical-flows-storyboards), then one For you todo with links and screenshots. open_review_max_h over 48: per open_review slice over 48 h, start or steer '<app> review refresh': check off a todo the owner already answered (a Staging pick, a chat reply), else cut it to one-link yes or no items and edit it in place; never re-post to reset its age. demo_ci_ok 0: start or steer 'virev-demo CI fix' (object-only, push-ci, own green run); on a source flag fix this precheck. Never write lines/staging.json, deploy, or move to 5174 (c40).
